# Hair Rules Curly Whip Styling, 16 oz

## Define Thick Curls Without the Crunch

Hair Rules Curly Whip Styling defines coarse, wiry, and thick curls without leaving them stiff. Its protein-enriched formula tames frizz and protects curls from humidity, so they stay soft, supple, and shiny.

## Infuse Moisture Into Every Curl

Each application controls and defines your curls while delivering essential moisture. You get a polished, well-defined look that feels nourished, not weighed down.

## Versatile for Every Curl Style

Use it on twists, locks, braids, coils, and spirals, or pair it with your texturizers and silkeners. Its versatility makes it a practical choice for different styles and routines.

## Make It Your Styling Staple

Give your curly hair the definition and hydration it deserves. Add Curly Whip Styling to your routine today and enjoy curls that look defined, feel soft, and keep their shape.
